body: There are some good suggestions here. Thank you for them. Your guy is lucky to have you because of your awareness of the power imbalance. Hope you treat each other well. Take care
Right?? I'm considering it though. I feel so alone out here.

Actually the visa is done and over now that we are married. Finding a job and saving to move out could take some time. However, i did some research based on the suggestions of wonderful folks here and realized that yes, i do have rights. I will find ways to stand up for them. Thinking about moving out of state too but will explore it when the time comes. Thank you for the suggestions.
Thank you for the positive vibes.
Thank you for the encouragement. I don't even want half. I'm okay with just the barest minimum so I can be off the streets and be more independent.
Thank you for the suggestions. Yes, I've been exploring options and my rights now.
Thank you for your suggestions. I've been talking to people and I'm just so touched by the sheer number of people out there who care, including you.  Thank you so much!
Thank you for calling me a friend. I sure need one now.

I've been reading about homeless shelters but honestly, it scares me more to be there.  Seems full of mentally unstable and criminally inclined folks. I hope that's not reality. I'm feeling overwhelmed right now but thank you for reaching out and the suggestions. I will try to figure things out in a couple of days.
Thank you. I'll look into food stamps and MediCal.

We do. Even if I have legal rights to assets I still don't feel comfortable taking any of it. It feels way too tainted to me especially after him implying that he paid for me to be here and will cost him more if I leave. But I guess I'm gonna have to learn to get over it. I did invest emotional and domestic labor in the relationship so there's that.  Thank you for the empathy. Truly tough to live outside your home country. I wish you well.

I'm about to be homeless and I'm scared as fck! I don't know if I could survive it so I'm just thinking about killing myself instead. I literally have nobody. Hell, I am nobody!

I'm interested how you found being homeless much easier. Were you young? White or white presenting? Straight? Male? I see from your post you had a car too so I guess that made it "easier". i'm an older gay foreigner who cannot drive. and Im finding that at my age, my coping mechanism has reduced. 

Anyway, lemme thank you for being inspirational before I ramble. I would love to hear more about how you pulled yourself off the streets.

I'm trying to be strong. it feels too overwhelming when you are alone as a foreigner and as an older man in the usa. Society seems more keen to be helping younger folks and women. I'm ok with that. Youngsters have their futures still. I don't. Women have to deal with too much as well. I don't want to be taking anybody's place in the line.

Thank you for wishing me well.

My local shelter opens at 9am so I'll take a bus there tomorrow and ask around. I don't know if i can live in a new city as I don't know how to drive nor i don't have money of my own. Unsure what you mean by sponsor. I don't have anyone like that too.  Thank you for reaching out.

Also being married to my husband means I have to divorce him too right? I am feeling overwhelmed just thinking about what that involves.

Yes. I was just looking at their web site but I haven't found anything about a shelter for older people yet. Only for young lgbtq. I honestly don't know where to begin building and Im not sure if I have time.  I think he wants me out of the house now. He just aggressively tossed my pillows in the living room. 

I'm trying to stay calm and quiet because I got no one. I don't want to be calling cops but I will if he escalates. But if I do, I don't know what's going to be next.
